sculpt_prop_bonfire.notes: Sculpted fire pit: oval ring of ten field stones, four charred split logs leaning into a tent, a fallen log, ash bed. Vertex colours on every LOD, no textures, no flame mesh (flames + light stay code). Families Wood_bark / LightWood_bark as before plus a new Stone_stone.
